import pytest
from isort.wrap import import_statement

# Define a default configuration equivalent
class Config:
    def __init__(self, multi_line_output=None, wrap_length=None, line_length=None,
                 include_trailing_comma=False, indent="    ", comment_prefix="#", 
                 ignore_comments=False, balanced_wrapping=False):
        self.multi_line_output = multi_line_output
        self.wrap_length = wrap_length
        self.line_length = line_length
        self.include_trailing_comma = include_trailing_comma
        self.indent = indent
        self.comment_prefix = comment_prefix
        self.ignore_comments = ignore_comments
        self.balanced_wrapping = balanced_wrapping

DEFAULT_CONFIG = Config()

def test_import_statement_basic():
    result = import_statement(
        import_start="from module import",
        from_imports=["ClassA", "ClassB"],
        comments=[],
        line_separator="\n",
        config=DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        multi_line_output=None,
        explode=False
    )
    expected = "from module import ClassA,\n    ClassB"
    assert result == expected

def test_import_statement_empty_from_imports():
    result = import_statement(
        import_start="from module import",
        from_imports=[],
        comments=[],
        line_separator="\n",
        config=DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        multi_line_output=None,
        explode=False
    )
    expected = "from module import"
    assert result == expected

def test_import_statement_explode():
    result = import_statement(
        import_start="from module import",
        from_imports=["ClassA", "ClassB", "ClassC"],
        comments=[],
        line_separator="\n",
        config=DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        multi_line_output=None,
        explode=True
    )
    expected = "from module import ClassA,\n    ClassB,\n    ClassC"
    assert result == expected

def test_import_statement_with_comments():
    result = import_statement(
        import_start="from module import",
        from_imports=["ClassA"],
        comments=["This is a class"],
        line_separator="\n",
        config=DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        multi_line_output=None,
        explode=False
    )
    expected = "from module import ClassA  # This is a class"
    assert result == expected

def test_import_statement_balanced_wrapping():
    custom_config = Config(
        multi_line_output="Modes.VERTICAL",
        wrap_length=20,
        line_length=80,
        include_trailing_comma=True,
        indent="    ",
        comment_prefix="#",
        ignore_comments=False,
        balanced_wrapping=True
    )
    result = import_statement(
        import_start="from module import",
        from_imports=["ClassA", "ClassB", "ClassC", "ClassD"],
        comments=[],
        line_separator="\n",
        config=custom_config,
        multi_line_output="Modes.VERTICAL",
        explode=False
    )
    expected = "from module import ClassA,\n    ClassB,\n    ClassC,\n    ClassD"
    assert result == expected
